name: clankers market
description: b01lers 2026 / clankers market: User-controlled data is concatenated into an OS command executed through a shell instead of being passed as an argument vector. Injection type is Command Injection. Attack surface: web parameters feeding utility endpoints (ping, dns, convert, archive, render) that shell out. Recommended strategy: utils.run_command executes every git operation with shell=True and cwd=/tmp/git_storage, and the repository setup writes flag.txt into that same directory. Any user-controlled fragment that reaches a git command string becomes a shell metacharacter injection with full command execution in the container. Identify which route concatenates request data into run_command.
vuln_type: Command Injection through a shell=True git wrapper
target_tech_stack: Python + Flask + git CLI, agent/LLM-themed storage backend
scoring_rationale: Estimated from local source/README, not official CTF points or solves.
